provenance.method: Read-only inspection of repository rules, existing scripts, captions, reports and rendered event timelines; explicit AI editorial review of 177 Day02–60 quiz/replay pairs plus the separate Day01 source and all three quiz exchanges.
provenance.turn_id_convention: A01–A06 and B01–B06 are stable array-position aliases introduced by this audit.
provenance.time_convention: Seconds from the episode start; event end includes the shared padded slot, not a measured speech end.
provenance.reproduction: Run build_content_audit.py --series-root <series> --day01-root <day01> --repo-root <repo> --out-dir <audit>. Mapping uses actual saved timeline events, never recomputes the failed heuristic.

coverage.day01_quiz_mapping: Separate adapter for data.json rows and youtube/synchronized_timeline.json; see day01_review.

user_overrides_to_preserve: Default English teaching audio, with English dialogue retained in every language track.
English text stays visible; Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean translations are selectable CC.
Four selectable translated teaching-audio tracks, shared synchronized timeline, 600 seconds per lesson, 60-day sequence.
Deliberate listening repetition and response pauses are pedagogical choices, not inherently padding.
The user has already selected languages; do not ask again or restore a Chinese-only default.

rules.requirement: Independent factual verification and listener-focused script review.
Brief, canonical video/claims, independent verification, listener review, audio checks, final QA and package review.
Complete required QA items and approval bound to the current final SHA; decoding is only part of assembly checking.
No unchanged visual state longer than 15 seconds.
Open with the audience question or concrete hook, rather than a greeting and generic agenda.
Close with the promised answer, an accessible viewer question and a justified subscription invitation.
Record current official verification for factual claims; distinguish invented teaching examples from real-world rules.
Title alternatives and meaningful audience-focused metadata; title limits are warnings.
Identify owner decisions for paid promotion, synthetic-content disclosure, children’s audience and publication schedule.
For English narration, review materials retain narration-language and Traditional Chinese metadata.
1920×1080/30fps master and the specified encoding and normalized audio profile; covered by the separate media audit.
Approved server-side provider and channel voice; this audit does not validate any substitute voice approval.

workflow_findings.finding: Existing custom QC only validates duration, H264/720p, decode, hashes, ordered captions and source voice mapping. It is not the repository QA suite or an approval.
workflow_findings.limits: Absence was established in the available episode/series working files. No remote review system was queried, so no assertion is made about uninspected remote records.

workflow_findings.finding: Day02–60 share a generic greeting and closing rather than a concise episode-specific hook and outcome. Shared intro/outro cards account for many of the 135 >15-second states.
workflow_findings.remediation: Revise and translate concise episode-specific openings/endings while preserving the authorized teaching format and 600-second total.

workflow_findings.finding: No explicit claims/source-verification record accompanies safety and travel-process statements, for example seat-belt handling (Day31), a phone trapped in a seat (Day32) and baggage rechecking (Day43).
workflow_findings.remediation: Separate fictional scenario details from real-world guidance and record official sources for the latter. Do not treat fictional gate numbers as real schedule claims.

workflow_findings.finding: Episode metadata contains a single Chinese title, generic feature text, chapters and AI disclosure; required English metadata and owner decision fields are not provided in the production packages.
workflow_findings.remediation: Complete episode-specific metadata and the upload decision checklist. Keep useful day numbering for this explicitly requested sequential course.

workflow_findings.finding: Offline reports validate loopback HTTP only; direct file:// startup was not tested. The voice-load error handler returns the selector to English without restoring player.muted to offlineMuted.
workflow_findings.remediation: Exercise direct-file loading where supported and a failed alternate-track request; explicitly restore the English mute state in the fallback.
